security_scope: Read-only preflight validates elevated admin, original HEAD/branch/origin, exact compiled V2/V3 hashes, protected previous SCM switch marker, stopped manual LocalService SCM and service SID configuration.
Worker account credential is locally decrypted from existing DPAPI only after prerequisites; never logged or uploaded.
New V2 service-test marker is created exactly once using FileMode.CreateNew immediately before Start-Service; no deletion or automatic replay.
Windows SCM process token is checked for LocalService S-1-5-19 and actual derived service SID group.

Named pipe DACL retrieved with GetFileSecurityW under short-lived impersonated worker token instead of admin; inspect .NET RawSecurityDescriptor allow ACE masks and forbidden instance creation, WRITE_DAC, WRITE_OWNER.

Independent worker V3 native probe tests individual evidence-dir forbidden rights and ledger generic write denial, followed by SID-authorized named pipe AUTH_PROBE with explicit client PipeAccessRights.ReadWrite.
Service is stopped in finally if start was attempted, including BLOCK/FAIL; stop cannot be assumed if stop verification fails.
GitHub QA receipt contains redacted results and SHA-256 readback, not credential, full SDDL or other sensitive bytes.
known_limitations: Static source inspection is not a native Windows compile/runtime check for inlined C# helpers.
This is an attestation-only service, not a secure production evidence writer; no W01-W12, job confinement or grouped QA.
If service start, worker logon, token readback, DACL or stop fails, record BLOCK/FAIL and preserve marker/state without rerun.
No SCM config, account, ACL, credential file, ledger, original worktree or F0 changes are allowed.
